all_original_proposals.prior_family_row: | E2 F P | IndividualFeedingConnection functional directed consumer Individual → food Agent or Subject; PopulationFeedingConnection consumer Population → observed resource Population/material pool. Persistent dispositions distinct from observed feeding episodes.
